issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer err in assessing the psychological risk of returning the applicant to Hungary?
issues.applicant_position: Officer ignored her psychological evidence and misconstrued documentary evidence on country conditions.
issues.result_quote: did not err assessing the psychological risk of returning the applicant to Hungary

issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer breach procedural fairness by not holding an oral hearing under paragraph 113(b) of the IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: Oral hearing was required under Zokai; she would have shown the officer a psychologist's report and H&C evidence.
issues.result_quote: did not breach the duty of fairness by failing to convoke an oral hearing under paragraph 113(b) of the IRPA

issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer apply the wrong test in finding adequate state protection in Hungary?
issues.applicant_position: Officer wrongly relied on Villafranca, a terrorism case, and did not follow Mendivil on targeted applicants.
issues.result_quote: applied the correct test to determine that the state of Hungary could continue to adequately protect the applicant
